title: Mande languages - Wikipedia
text: The Mande languages are a family of languages spoken in several countries in West Africa by the Mandé peoples. They include Maninka, Mandinka, Soninke, Bambara, Kpelle, Jula, Bozo, Mende, Susu, and Vai.
